C0-17
COOLING -- RADIATOR
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE UPPER FRONT FENDER APRON SEAL AND
UPPER RADIATOR SUPPORT SEAL
2. DRAIN ENGINE COOLANT
3. REMOVE BUMPER COVER (See page B0--4)
4. REMOVE AIR CLEANER
5. REMOVE ENGINE COOLANT RESERVOIR
{a) Disconnect the 3 radiator reservoir hoses.
(b) Remove the bolt and engine coolant reservoir.
6. REMOVE RADIATOR ASSEMBLY
(a) Disconnect the No. 1 electric cooling fan connector.
(b) Disconnect the No. 2 electric cooling fan connector.
(c) Disconnect the upper radiator hose.
(d) Disconnect the lower radiator hose.
(e) Disconnect the 2 NT oil cooler hoses.
(f} Remove the 3 bolts, and disconnect the hood !ock.
(g) Remove the 2 bolts and center brace.
(h) Remove the 2 bolts, 2 nuts and 2 condensor upper sup­
ports.
(i) w/ Cruise control system:
Remove the bolt, and disconnect the cruise control ac­
cuator.
(i) Remove the 2 bolts and radiator upper support.
(k) Remove the 2 upper radiator support bushings.
(I) Remove the radiator assembly.
(m) Remove the 2 lower radiator support bushings.
7. REMOVE ELECTRIC COOLING FAN FROM RADIA­
TOR
Remove the 2 bolts and cooling fan assembly.
